mechanism_narrative: Lower federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) are associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as they reflect accommodative monetary policy that supports equity valuations through lower discount rates and increased liquidity.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 1.5% is not associated with significantly positive 20-day returns (t-test p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 1.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS above 1.5% is not associated with significantly negative 20-day returns (t-test p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential mortgage credit (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a contraction in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic weakness and negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS m/m change < -0.5% and HOUST m/m change < -0.5%
failure_condition: The joint condition of RSAFS and HOUST both declining by more than 0.5% m/m is not associated with significantly negative 20-day returns (t-test p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (2017=100 base), it signals a contraction in the supply chain and manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO below 100 is not associated with significantly negative 20-day returns (t-test p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE above 5.0% is not associated with significantly negative 20-day returns (t-test p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) are associated with stronger economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as they reflect increased consumer confidence and construction activity.
failure_condition: HOUST above 1000 is not associated with significantly positive 20-day returns (t-test p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

failure_condition: FEDFUNDS above 1.5% is not associated with significantly negative 60-day returns (t-test p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

failure_condition: UNRATE above 5.0% is not associated with significantly negative 5-day returns (t-test p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.
